query: select latest.blocked_player_id, latest.created_at as "blocked_at!", snapshot.display_name as "display_name?", target.trainer_name from ( select distinct on (blocked_player_id) blocked_player_id, kind, created_at from player_blocks where player_id = $1 order by blocked_player_id, id desc ) latest join players target on target.id = latest.blocked_player_id left join lateral ( select display_name from player_discord_snapshots where player_id = latest.blocked_player_id order by id desc limit 1 ) snapshot on true where latest.kind = 'blocked' order by latest.created_at desc, latest.blocked_player_id
